paignton.snapshot: Paignton sits in the middle of a busy South Devon fibre build, and the workwear trade here splits two ways. The national build contractors and structured-cabling firms run fleets of engineers and buy on trade accounts, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account. We run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side so the crew and the single installer are kitted the same way.
paignton.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of South Devon
s1loc: Paignton is well into the full-fibre rollout, with Openreach pushing fibre to the premises across the town and the wider Torbay area while the alternative networks build alongside. Devon-grown alt-net Jurassic Fibre has been extending its own gigabit network through Torbay and South Devon, and the Connecting Devon and Somerset programme keeps Project Gigabit work moving into the harder-to-reach premises around the bay. The build runs through districts like Preston, Goodrington, Clifton, Blatchcombe and the town centre, keeping civils gangs, jointers and fibre engineers working at cabinets and on the streets day in and day out.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a steady commercial scene. The estates around Yalberton and the White Rock and Brixham Road corridor host warehousing, light manufacturing and offices, while Paignton Zoo, the harbour and seafront hotels, schools and a spread of multi-site tourism and leisure businesses all need structured cabling in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre, plus CCTV and access control. The Torbay Hospital and college sites nearby add further network and cabling work. Local cabling and security installers wire these units and businesses across the town, taking on commercial premises and homes alike.
